title: Buried Power Rails and Nano-Scale TSV: Technology Boosters for Backside Power Delivery Network and 3D Heterogeneous Integration
notes: Passive BSPDN test vehicle: n-TSV from backside landing on BPR; W/Ru/Co metallization splits; Kelvin, BPR and chain resistance vs Raphael simulation. Text layer font-encoded; numbers read from renders.

title: TSV-less Power Delivery for Wafer-scale Assemblies and Interposers
orgs: Center for Heterogeneous Integration and Performance Scaling (CHIPS), Henry Samueli School of Engineering, UCLA
notes: Dielet-side PDN via through-polymer vias (TPVs) on Si-IF: DC PDN and solder-current models, 100 um surrogate SU-8/Cu TPV coupon, 500 um fusion-bonded die coupon with 3 nm ALD Al2O3.

title: Low temperature backside damascene processing on temporary carrier wafer targeting 7μm and 5μm pitch microbumps for N equal and greater than 2 die to wafer TCB stacking

title: Chip Last Fanout Chip on Substrate (FOCoS) Solution for Chiplets Integration

title: Reliability Challenges of High-Density Fan-out Packaging for High-Performance Computing Applications
